fullContentHtml:
RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the CBTST Exam Date for the Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC Graduate Level posts. RRB has invited huge number of vacancies for NTPC Graduate Level post recruitment during the 16 March 2026 to 27 March 2026. There were 5,810 posts were called for the hiring of RRB NTPC Graduate Level in various trades. The CBTST examination is going to be conducted in September 2026. Candidates who qualified for CBT II examination can check their RRB NTPC CEN 06/2025 Graduate Level CBTST Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 October 2025
  • Last Date : 27 November 2025 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 November 2025
  • Correction / Modified Form : 30 November 2025 to 09 December 2025
  • Application Status : 20 January 2026
  • Exam Date CBT-I : 16-27 March 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 Days Before Exam
  • Admit Card : 12 March 2026
  • Answer Key Available : 06 April 2026
  • CBT-I Result : 11 June 2026
  • CBAT/ CBTST Exam Date : 30 September 2026
  • DV Date : December 2026
  • CBT-II Exam Date : 10 July 2026
  • CBT-II Exam City Details : 30 June 2026
  • CBT-II Admit Card : 06 July 2026
  • CBT-II Answer Key : 15 July 2026
  • CBT-II Result : 27 August 2026
  • CBTST Exam Date : September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
